“Exit polls 2012: How the vote has shifted.”The Washington Post November 6, 2012.
Final exit poll results from interviews of randomly selected voters as they exited voting places across the country on Tuesday, November 6, 2012.
Florida, North Carolina, Ohio and Wisconsin polls included telephone interviews with early voters.
The poll was conducted by Edison Media Research for the National Election Pool, the Washington Post and other media organizations.
Typical characteristics have a margin of sampling error of plus or minus four percentage points.“Don’t know” and “other” responses not included.
